Each year, we conduct targeted supplier audits which we consider valid for four years. We  
work to increase the total number of supplier facilities that are covered by valid audits. In 
some instances, facilities may have been audited with both EICC VAP and other on-site audits, 
which include Intel-led targeted audits and quality assessments that include CSR criteria.
